jobs.title: Senior Solutions Consultant, Supply Chain Optimization
jobs.description:
About Kinaxis:
**About Kinaxis**


Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!  

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.  

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
About the team:
**Location**


This is a remote position, and we are open to hiring candidates from anywhere across the EMEA region. **About the team**


The **Senior Consultant** as a fully proficient professional will be responsible for understanding Kinaxis customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and will be committed to helping our customers solve complex issues in their supply chain management practice. The incumbent will work with new and existing customers and will provide expert guidance in integrating our product offerings so that our customers can start to experience the immediate value of Kinaxis solutions. The incumbent will act as a functional lead on projects by providing consulting services and leadership during deployment of Maestro supply chain software and leverage advanced knowledge of the product and supply chain industry trends and best practices to achieve desired outcomes.
About the role:
**What you will do**

* Independently lead business requirements discovery sessions for implementations of advanced complexity, multi\-phase workstreams and broad scope.
* Partner with Solution Architect in the process design and technical direction of complex configurations.
* Execute product configurations of advanced complexity, according to customer needs and approved solution architecture.
* Act as the first level of escalation and oversee the troubleshooting and resolution of complex configuration issues for the project team.
* Apply advanced mathematical models, optimization techniques and artificial intelligence algorithms to complex supply chain planning scenarios to improve customer supply chain performance and achieve business objectives.
* Execute the validation and testing of the solution, capture user feedback and develop recommendations for escalations, roadblocks, and documentation.
* Independently lead complex deployment workshops with a focus on training and guiding customers on how the solution was configured and how to achieve immediate value from their investment.
* Provide technical leadership and recommendations to the Associate, Entry and Intermediate Solution Consultants during project milestones and critical deployment escalations.
* Guide and mentor more junior consultants throughout the project lifecycle.

 **What we are looking for**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5 \+ years of in\-depth experience in software implementation or deployment within the supply chain planning or supply chain execution space or business experience in supply planning, demand planning, inventory management, manufacturing.
* 2 to 3 years’ experience in a functional leadership capacity for system configuration or system deployments.
* 2 to 3 years’ experience in business process design for supply chain software implementations.
* Passion for working in customer\-facing roles and able to demonstrate strong interpersonal, communication facilitation and presentation skills.
* Excellent problem solving and critical thinking skills, able to synthesize a high volume of complex information to determine best course of action.
* Self\-starter who shows initiative in their work and learning and can excel in a fast\-paced work environment.
* Proven leadership skills within a team as well as a successful track record with customers and executive sponsors.
* Ability to work in a collaborative matrixed environment with multiple team members.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing.
* Advanced level knowledge and hands\-on application of supply chain best practices and concepts as it relates to forecasting, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), Constraint Management, and Production Scheduling.
* Ability to lead complex business requirements gathering sessions with customers and system end users.
* Experience working with supply chain processes and manufacturing planning solutions such as Maestro, SAP, Oracle or Blue Yonder applications to support supply chain activities.
* Proficiency in SQL, R and/or Java Script.
* Open to travel 50% on average and 75% occasionally and can work effectively when working remotely from client sites.

jobs.title: EMEA Sales Planning Analyst
jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Dublin, Ireland; Warsaw, Poland**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in sales operations, business planning, data analysis, or a similar commercial strategy role.
* 2 years of experience with program management.
* Experience with SQL or other data querying languages to extract insights from internal databases.
* Experience with sales planning tools.
* Experience working with datasets.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with tools such as Anaplan or Salesforce.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management experience.
* Familiarity with the EMEA Public Cloud commercial landscape and macroeconomic trends.
* Knowledge of Google Cloud Product Suite.
* Ability to work in a changing environment and manage multiple operational deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear summaries for stakeholders.

**About the job**
-----------------


As an EMEA Sales Planning Analyst, you will support the development and execution of the go\-to\-market (GTM) strategy for Google Cloud across the EMEA region. You will serve as a subject matter expert on internal planning systems and data pipelines, ensuring that sales leadership has the accurate, actionable data needed to drive growth and efficiency.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

Ireland: €94000 \- €96000 (EUR) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

Poland: zł232000 \- zł237000 (PLN) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Execute on key operational processes related to the implementation of EMEA GTM strategy by pulling and analyzing account data, updating territory assignments and managing quota cascade.
* Collaborate with Regional Sales Operations to ensure data alignment and resolve discrepancies during the annual planning cycle.
* Identify and document best practices to standardize sales planning processes across EMEA markets.
* Act as a topic matter expert relating to our systems, processes, data pipelines, policies and tools.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders across the organization.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: GIS Analyst 2, Data Informed Futures - Pediatrics (Limited)
jobs.description:
**Description**  

The Geographic Information Systems Analyst 2 (GIS Analyst) turns geographic data into insights that help children and communities thrive. UCLA’s Data Informed Futures team is seeking a GIS Analyst to prepare and analyze geospatial data, maintain high\-quality spatial databases, and create maps and web\-based products that support research, community planning, and action. You will collaborate with technical and nontechnical partners, translate complex data into understandable map products, and contribute to a national initiative focused on identifying and addressing geographic and social inequities in children’s health and development.

*This is a limited position that may convert to career.*

  

Salary Range: $33\.09 \- $65\.77 Hourly

  

Pay range: $33\.09 \- $65\.77 an hour  

  

**Qualifications** **Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related area and/or equivalent experience or training.
* Working knowledge of GIS software, applications programming, database and table structure and design, user interface and experience design and web application development.
* Demonstrated project management skills. Understanding of cartographic skills to create spatially explicit map products
* Interpersonal skills to work well with both technical and non\-technical personnel at various levels in the organization
* Ability to communicate technical information in a clear and concise manner
* Self\-motivated, able to learn quickly, meet deadlines and demonstrate problem solving skills.
* Demonstrated strong commitment to customer service, attention to detail, and continuous improvement.
* Must pass a background check

 **Preferred:**

* Minimum two (2\) years of related experience.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative Residential Real Estate & PropTech
jobs.description:
DomiDocs® is seeking an experienced full\-time Inside Sales Representative to sell residential real estate technology products to property owners. The position is structured as a 1099 independent contractor. It offers an opportunity to get in on the ground floor of DomiDocs’ next phase of growth with an established residential PropTech company that has proven products in the market and is positioned for explosive growth.

The Inside Sales Representative will proactively create sales opportunities, conduct consultative discovery conversations, identify and solve customer problems, clearly communicate product value, and close new business. The ideal candidate will be energized by the opportunity to help expand a company that is disrupting multiple lines of business within residential real estate and is well on its way to becoming a category\-defining company.

**About DomiDocs®**

DomiDocs® is at the forefront of disrupting the residential property\-management vertical, a market representing approximately $55 trillion in value. Through its AI\-powered Homeowner Enablement Platform®, DomiDocs brings together products and services that have never previously been aggregated under one corporate umbrella.

The company is disrupting multiple verticals and lines of business within residential PropTech, including residential property\-fraud protection, homeowners’ insurance, and property taxes.

DomiDocs is an established real estate technology company positioned for explosive growth as it disrupts multiple verticals within the residential property\-management industry. The company has proven products in the market and an established customer base.

Explore the future of homeownership at DomiDocs.com.

**What You'll Do**

* Generate opportunities through outreach, leads, referrals, and follow\-up.
* Assess homeowner needs and recommend appropriate DomiDocs solutions.
* Explain property risks, service options, product value, and homeowner benefits.
* Build trust, overcome objections, meet quotas, and close business.
* Maintain accurate HubSpot records, sales stages, and follow\-ups.
* Identify cross\-sell, upsell, renewal, and recurring\-revenue opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams throughout the customer lifecycle.
* Communicate professionally by phone, video, email, messaging, and CRM.
* Use HubSpot, Microsoft Office, SharePoint, Slack, and Teams.
* Stay organized, responsive, accountable, and adaptable while working remotely.

**What We’re Looking For** 

* Residential real estate experience and practical transaction knowledge.
* Experience in mortgage, title, escrow, PropTech, brokerage, homebuilding, or acquisitions.
* Proven closing\-focused sales success with measurable goals or quotas.
* Experience prospecting, building pipelines, overcoming objections, and closing business.
* Experience managing prospects, opportunities, follow\-ups, and CRM sales stages.
* Explain technology, services, risks, and value in customer\-focused language.
* Strong organization, documentation, relationship\-management, and follow\-up skills.
* Learn proprietary services and AI systems; work independently and remotely.

Updated Job Description Sections

**Compensation**

* **$50,000 annual base salary**
* **Uncapped commissions**
* **Expected total annual compensation: $75,000–$150,000\+**
* Opportunity to earn **residual income through recurring revenue**

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* **Work from anywhere** — fully remote within the U.S.
* **Equity opportunities** — earn ownership as you grow with us.
* **Fast\-paced, forward\-thinking environment** — where your ideas and contributions matter.
* **Growth opportunity** — join an established PropTech company entering its next phase of expansion.
* **Category\-defining products** — represent proven solutions designed to disrupt multiple areas of residential real estate.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with both B2C and B2B sales.
* Experience managing a sales pipeline in a CRM system.
* Experience using Microsoft Office and Slack.

**Work Location and Schedule**

* Remote within the U.S.; may reside in any U.S. time zone.
* Full\-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. EST

**Independent Contractor Status \& Equipment Requirements**

* This position is a 1099 independent contractor.
* The contractor is responsible for providing and maintaining the equipment necessary to perform the role remotely.
* Required equipment includes a reliable laptop or computer, an additional monitor, and a professional\-quality headset suitable for phone, video, and customer\-facing sales activities.
* The contractor must also maintain reliable high\-speed internet access and an appropriate remote workspace.
* As a 1099 independent contractor, the individual is responsible for applicable federal, state, and local tax obligations.

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid training
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Select all applicable areas of professional experience: Mortgage lending or loan origination, title, escrow, or closing services, residential real estate technology or PropTech, real estate brokerage or residential sales, residential real estate acquisitions.
* Do you have professional experience working directly with homeowners or residential property owners? If yes, briefly describe your experience.
* Please provide the URL to your LinkedIn profile.
* How many years of professional sales experience do you have? Please briefly describe your sales background, including the types of products or services you have sold and whether your experience is B2B, B2C, or both.
* How many years of residential real estate experience do you have? Please briefly describe your role, area of involvement, and the type of residential real estate experience you have.

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:

Support the team in the management of all tax certificates processed. Recommend strategies for acquiring properties and creating a pipeline for the Acquisition Team. * Ability to run GIS analyses on various data involving housing, transportation, public education, green space or related data.
* Knowledge of the interoperability between multiple hardware and software environments.

* Ability to manage the installation, configuration, and deployment of software programs and patches, database performance metrics, SQL, and reporting functions and ability to develop standards and compliance guidelines for the implementation of processes, procedures, and databases.
* Ability to provide moderate\-level insight, advice and expertise to other professionals, management, and external contacts in an assigned functional area.

jobs.title: Transportation Planning Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview:

Kimley\-Horn is looking for Planning graduates to join our Nashville, TN office focusing on Transportation in 2027! This is not a remote position.
Responsibilities:
* Support comprehensive transportation planning, corridor studies, long\-range transportation plans, and land use plans.
* Develop clear, data\-driven planning materials through multimodal transportation analysis, GIS mapping, visual presentations, and technical writing to support project development.
* Participate in stakeholder meetings, public workshops, community outreach events, and agency coordination meetings.
* Prepare technical memoranda, planning reports, presentations, and planning recommendations.
* Collaborate with internal and external teams on transportation, transit, land development, and urban design projects.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Transportation Planning, Urban Planning, Civil Engineering, Geography, Public Policy, Urban Design, or a related field.
* 0\-3 years of relevant experience in transportation planning.
* Interest in multimodal transportation, transit, land use, and community planning.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to synthesize technical information into clear, client\-ready deliverables.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.


Preferred Skills:* Experience with Esri ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online
* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite.
* Experience with Power BI and other data analysis tools.
* Experience with urban and graphic design applications (SketchUp, Photoshop, Illustrator) · Experience supporting public involvement, stakeholder engagement, or community outreach efforts.
* Familiarity with travel demand modeling, transportation simulation, or transportation forecasting. · Familiarity with urban design principles, placemaking, and complete streets concepts.


Why Kimley\-Horn?:

At Kimley\-Horn, we do things differently. People, clients, and employees are at the forefront of who we are. Clients know we prioritize achieving their goals and growing their success. Employees know our culture and approach to business are built on a desire to provide an environment for everyone to flourish. Our commitment to quality is only as good as the people behind it— that’s why we welcome and develop passionate, hardworking, and proactive employees. We take pride in how our employee retention, robust benefits package, and company values have led to Kimley\-Horn’s placement on the Fortune “100 Best Companies to Work” list for 19 years! *Key Benefits at Kimley\-Horn** Exceptional Retirement Plan: 2\-to1\- company match on up to 4% of eligible compensation (salary \+ bonus) and additional profit\-sharing contribution.
* Comprehensive Health Coverage: Low\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance options.
* Time Off: Personal leave, flexible scheduling, floating holidays, and half\-day Fridays.
* Financial Wellness: Student loan matching in our 401(k), and performance\-based bonuses.
* Professional Development: Tuition reimbursement and extensive internal training programs.
* Family\-Friendly Benefits: New Parent Leave, family building benefits, and childcare resources.

new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative Residential Real Estate & PropTech
new_jobs.description:
DomiDocs® is seeking an experienced full\-time Inside Sales Representative to sell residential real estate technology products to property owners. The position is structured as a 1099 independent contractor. It offers an opportunity to get in on the ground floor of DomiDocs’ next phase of growth with an established residential PropTech company that has proven products in the market and is positioned for explosive growth.

The Inside Sales Representative will proactively create sales opportunities, conduct consultative discovery conversations, identify and solve customer problems, clearly communicate product value, and close new business. The ideal candidate will be energized by the opportunity to help expand a company that is disrupting multiple lines of business within residential real estate and is well on its way to becoming a category\-defining company.

**About DomiDocs®**

DomiDocs® is at the forefront of disrupting the residential property\-management vertical, a market representing approximately $55 trillion in value. Through its AI\-powered Homeowner Enablement Platform®, DomiDocs brings together products and services that have never previously been aggregated under one corporate umbrella.

The company is disrupting multiple verticals and lines of business within residential PropTech, including residential property\-fraud protection, homeowners’ insurance, and property taxes.

DomiDocs is an established real estate technology company positioned for explosive growth as it disrupts multiple verticals within the residential property\-management industry. The company has proven products in the market and an established customer base.

Explore the future of homeownership at DomiDocs.com.

**What You'll Do**

* Generate opportunities through outreach, leads, referrals, and follow\-up.
* Assess homeowner needs and recommend appropriate DomiDocs solutions.
* Explain property risks, service options, product value, and homeowner benefits.
* Build trust, overcome objections, meet quotas, and close business.
* Maintain accurate HubSpot records, sales stages, and follow\-ups.
* Identify cross\-sell, upsell, renewal, and recurring\-revenue opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams throughout the customer lifecycle.
* Communicate professionally by phone, video, email, messaging, and CRM.
* Use HubSpot, Microsoft Office, SharePoint, Slack, and Teams.
* Stay organized, responsive, accountable, and adaptable while working remotely.

**What We’re Looking For** 

* Residential real estate experience and practical transaction knowledge.
* Experience in mortgage, title, escrow, PropTech, brokerage, homebuilding, or acquisitions.
* Proven closing\-focused sales success with measurable goals or quotas.
* Experience prospecting, building pipelines, overcoming objections, and closing business.
* Experience managing prospects, opportunities, follow\-ups, and CRM sales stages.
* Explain technology, services, risks, and value in customer\-focused language.
* Strong organization, documentation, relationship\-management, and follow\-up skills.
* Learn proprietary services and AI systems; work independently and remotely.

Updated Job Description Sections

**Compensation**

* **$50,000 annual base salary**
* **Uncapped commissions**
* **Expected total annual compensation: $75,000–$150,000\+**
* Opportunity to earn **residual income through recurring revenue**

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* **Work from anywhere** — fully remote within the U.S.
* **Equity opportunities** — earn ownership as you grow with us.
* **Fast\-paced, forward\-thinking environment** — where your ideas and contributions matter.
* **Growth opportunity** — join an established PropTech company entering its next phase of expansion.
* **Category\-defining products** — represent proven solutions designed to disrupt multiple areas of residential real estate.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with both B2C and B2B sales.
* Experience managing a sales pipeline in a CRM system.
* Experience using Microsoft Office and Slack.

**Work Location and Schedule**

* Remote within the U.S.; may reside in any U.S. time zone.
* Full\-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. EST

**Independent Contractor Status \& Equipment Requirements**

* This position is a 1099 independent contractor.
* The contractor is responsible for providing and maintaining the equipment necessary to perform the role remotely.
* Required equipment includes a reliable laptop or computer, an additional monitor, and a professional\-quality headset suitable for phone, video, and customer\-facing sales activities.
* The contractor must also maintain reliable high\-speed internet access and an appropriate remote workspace.
* As a 1099 independent contractor, the individual is responsible for applicable federal, state, and local tax obligations.

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid training
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Select all applicable areas of professional experience: Mortgage lending or loan origination, title, escrow, or closing services, residential real estate technology or PropTech, real estate brokerage or residential sales, residential real estate acquisitions.
* Do you have professional experience working directly with homeowners or residential property owners? If yes, briefly describe your experience.
* Please provide the URL to your LinkedIn profile.
* How many years of professional sales experience do you have? Please briefly describe your sales background, including the types of products or services you have sold and whether your experience is B2B, B2C, or both.
* How many years of residential real estate experience do you have? Please briefly describe your role, area of involvement, and the type of residential real estate experience you have.

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: PLANNING ANALYST - COOK COUNTY LAND BANK AUTHORITY
new_jobs.description:
Provide technical support for the department's Tax Certificate Program, responsible for identifying, organizing, and tracking the acquisition of tax certificates from the Cook County Treasurer. Support the team in the management of all tax certificates processed. Recommend strategies for acquiring properties and creating a pipeline for the Acquisition Team. Prepare, develop, and implement analyses of internal and external data to identify, evaluate and make inferences on trends with the property portfolio, broader housing market, or communities where office is active.

  


**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Other Characteristics**


* Ability to run GIS analyses on various data involving housing, transportation, public education, green space or related data.
* Knowledge of the interoperability between multiple hardware and software environments.
* Ability to manage property or real estate data with an understanding of property transaction processes.
* Ability to manage the installation, configuration, and deployment of software programs and patches, database performance metrics, SQL, and reporting functions and ability to develop standards and compliance guidelines for the implementation of processes, procedures, and databases.
* Ability to provide moderate\-level insight, advice and expertise to other professionals, management, and external contacts in an assigned functional area.
* Ability to operate as a team player and communicate specialized knowledge team members, managers, and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of moderately complex principles and practices for a specialized area of focus.
 **Minimum Qualifications**

* Graduation from an accredited college or university with a Bachelor's Degree or higher and
* Two (2\) years of experience in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and
* Two (2\) years in planning, community development, or directly related experience or
* An equivalent combination of education and/or experience.

 **Physical Requirements**


Sedentary Work involves exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally or a negligible amount of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time.

***The duties listed are not set forth for purposes of limiting the assignment of work. They are not to be construed as a complete list of the many duties normally to be performed under a job title or those to be performed temporarily outside an employee's normal line of work.***

 **Group and Voluntary Benefits Offered**:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision
* Basic Term Life Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Deferred Compensation Program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Holidays, Vacation, and Sick Time
* Voluntary Benefits
* You May Qualify for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSLF)
* 
* For eligible employees the County has a hybrid work environment which allows employees telecommuting and flexible scheduling options.

new_jobs.title: Transportation Planning Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Kimley\-Horn is looking for Planning graduates to join our Nashville, TN office focusing on Transportation in 2027! This is not a remote position.
Responsibilities:
* Support comprehensive transportation planning, corridor studies, long\-range transportation plans, and land use plans.
* Develop clear, data\-driven planning materials through multimodal transportation analysis, GIS mapping, visual presentations, and technical writing to support project development.
* Participate in stakeholder meetings, public workshops, community outreach events, and agency coordination meetings.
* Prepare technical memoranda, planning reports, presentations, and planning recommendations.
* Collaborate with internal and external teams on transportation, transit, land development, and urban design projects.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Transportation Planning, Urban Planning, Civil Engineering, Geography, Public Policy, Urban Design, or a related field.
* 0\-3 years of relevant experience in transportation planning.
* Interest in multimodal transportation, transit, land use, and community planning.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to synthesize technical information into clear, client\-ready deliverables.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.


Preferred Skills:* Experience with Esri ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online
* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite.
* Experience with Power BI and other data analysis tools.
* Experience with urban and graphic design applications (SketchUp, Photoshop, Illustrator) · Experience supporting public involvement, stakeholder engagement, or community outreach efforts.
* Familiarity with travel demand modeling, transportation simulation, or transportation forecasting. · Familiarity with urban design principles, placemaking, and complete streets concepts.


Why Kimley\-Horn?:

At Kimley\-Horn, we do things differently. People, clients, and employees are at the forefront of who we are. Clients know we prioritize achieving their goals and growing their success. Employees know our culture and approach to business are built on a desire to provide an environment for everyone to flourish. Our commitment to quality is only as good as the people behind it— that’s why we welcome and develop passionate, hardworking, and proactive employees. We take pride in how our employee retention, robust benefits package, and company values have led to Kimley\-Horn’s placement on the Fortune “100 Best Companies to Work” list for 19 years! *Key Benefits at Kimley\-Horn** Exceptional Retirement Plan: 2\-to1\- company match on up to 4% of eligible compensation (salary \+ bonus) and additional profit\-sharing contribution.
* Comprehensive Health Coverage: Low\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance options.
* Time Off: Personal leave, flexible scheduling, floating holidays, and half\-day Fridays.
* Financial Wellness: Student loan matching in our 401(k), and performance\-based bonuses.
* Professional Development: Tuition reimbursement and extensive internal training programs.
* Family\-Friendly Benefits: New Parent Leave, family building benefits, and childcare resources.
